# Publish gate report

**Going out:** landing hero copy for Pebblebrook Tea Co., UK.

**Fixed (in the suggested copy below):**
- "The finest" is an unprovable superlative, so I removed it.
- "eco-friendly bags" is a broad green claim, the kind regulators challenge most. I replaced it with the policy's provable wording: plastic-free and home compostable.
- "organic" now reads "certified organic", matching the Soil Association claim on the policy list.
- "packed by hand" is only backed for tins, so the copy now says "Every tin packed by hand in Bristol".

**Suggested copy:**
> Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website. Certified organic loose leaf tea and plastic-free, home compostable tea bags. Every tin packed by hand in Bristol.

**Claims table**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website | On the policy list |
| The finest organic loose leaf | "Finest" is unproven and removed. "Organic" is on the list as certified organic. |
| eco-friendly bags | Unproven as worded. Replaced with plastic-free and home compostable, which is on the list. |
| packed by hand in Bristol | On the list for tins only |

**Disclosure:** no ad, sponsorship, affiliate or AI label is needed for this copy. The rating claim must stay in step with the live review count on the site, and the policy has no review date for it.

**Needs a decision:**
- Approve the rewritten copy. The policy names no approver, so I'm asking you for an explicit yes to this exact text.
- If you want to keep "finest" or "eco-friendly", I'd need a source added to the policy. I don't suggest it.

**Evidence log rows to paste:**
- 2026-11-17 | Landing hero | 4.8/5 from 1,200+ reviews on website | Policy list | brand-policy.md
- 2026-11-17 | Landing hero | Certified organic | Policy list | Soil Association
- 2026-11-17 | Landing hero | Plastic-free, home compostable bags | Policy list | brand-policy.md
- 2026-11-17 | Landing hero | Every tin packed by hand in Bristol | Policy list | brand-policy.md
- 2026-11-17 | Landing hero | "finest", "eco-friendly" | Removed, unproven | n/a

Not approved yet, so this should not publish as drafted.
